title: Salewa North America Recalls Khion Ski Boots Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The ski boots can inadvertently switch from "ski" to "walk" mode, the boots' upper cuffs can separate, and in the Khion Carbon model, the carbon boot shell can crack, posing a fall hazard and risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 1,300 (in addition, 300 were sold in Canada).

title: Chimparoo Baby Carriers by L'echarpe Porte-bonheur Recalled Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The carriers' side strap can loosen unexpectedly from the buckle, posing a fall hazard to the child in the carrier. Units: About 130 (in addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: LF Products Recalls Barstools Due to Fall Hazard; New Instructions Provided; Sold Exclusively at Bed Bath & Beyond
summary: Screws on the barstools can loosen, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 108,000 (in addition, about 6,200 units were sold in Canada).

title: Roylco Recalls Educational Light Cubes Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The light cube's lithium polymer battery can overheat and catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,400.

title: Samsung Expands Recall of Galaxy Note7 Smartphones Based on Additional Incidents with Replacement Phones; Serious Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery in the Galaxy Note7 smartphones can overheat and catch fire, posing serious fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1.9 million (This includes the 1 million Galaxy Note7s recalled on September 15, 2016).

title: Mamas & Papas Recalls Armadillo Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A loose latch on the stroller can cause the seat to tip back unexpectedly when infant is in the parent-facing position, posing a fall hazard to infants. Units: About 3,000 (In addition one was sold in Canada).

title: Specialized Recalls Road Bicycles Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The bicycle's rear wheel can come out of the dropout causing fractures in the rear triangle; presenting an injury hazard to riders. Units: About 1,000.

title: Aqua Lung Recalls Powerline Inflators Due to Injury and Drowning Hazards
summary: The inflation button can remain depressed and cause the buoyancy compensators to continue inflating, resulting in an uncontrolled ascent. This poses injury and drowning hazards to the diver. Units: About 53,000.

title: Gleason Recalls Hand Trucks Due to Laceration and Injury Hazards
summary: The wheel's plastic rims can break when overinflated, posing a laceration or injury hazard. Units: About 120,000.

title: Summer Infant Recalls Infant Bath Tubs Due to Risk of Impact Injury and Drowning
summary: Fabric slings on the recalled infant bath tubs can detach from the tub, posing a risk of impact injury and drowning. Units: About 86,000.

title: Wildhorn Outfitters Recalls to Repair Hammocks Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The cinch buckles that came with the hammocks and suspension kit can fail, causing straps to detach from hammock, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 9,700.

title: FULLBEAUTY Brands Recalls Children's Nightgowns Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The nightgowns fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 31,500.

title: Interlogix Recalls to Inspect Personal Panic Devices Due to Failure to Operate in an Emergency
summary: The wireless personal panic devices can fail to operate, which could result in the device not communicating with the security system if activated in the event of an emergency. Units: About 67,000.

title: Office Depot Recalls Winsley Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair can tip over when leaning back, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 129,000.

title: Sargent Art Recalls Craft Paints Due to Risk of Exposure to Bacteria
summary: The paint can contain harmful bacteria. Exposure to certain bacteria can have adverse health effects in immunocompromised individuals, posing a risk of serious illness including a bacterial infection. Consumers with healthy immune systems are not generally affected by the bacteria. Units: About 2.8

title: Glion Electric Scooters Recalled by Probity Cell Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The frame of the scooter can break where the unit folds, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 230.

title: Hallee Recalls Bed Canopies Due to Entanglement and Strangulation Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: A child can become entangled in the bed canopy, posing entanglement and strangulation hazards. Units: About 1,000.

title: Peg Perego Recalls Children's Ride-On Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: A relay on the circuit board can fail causing the vehicle's motor to overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 3,000.

title: Hearth & Home Technologies Recalls Wood Stoves Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: When the top load lid of the stove is being used, the handle can become disengaged from the locked position, allowing the lid to unexpectedly slam shut on the consumer's fingers. Units: About 650.

title: H-E-B Recalls Star Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Weld defects can cause the armrest to detach from base, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 600.

title: Fiddle Diddles Recalls Car Seat Strap Systems Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The carabiners attached to the strap system contain small internal parts that can become dislodged, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 250.

title: Cabela's Recalls Food Dehydrators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Defective wiring can cause a build-up of heat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,000.

title: Makita Recalls Circular Saws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The lower blade guard can malfunction and expose the blade, posing a laceration hazard and risk of injury to the consumer. Units: About 450.

title: Summer Classics Recalls Swivel Rocking Lounge Chairs Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The seat bucket of the lounge chairs can break away from the base while a user is in the chair, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 800.

title: Target Recalls Halloween LED Gel Clings Due to Choking and Button Battery Ingestion Hazards
summary: The gel clings can separate and expose the inner decal and LED/button battery compartment, posing choking and button battery ingestion hazards to children. Units: About 127,000.

title: Husqvarna Recalls Lawn Mowers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The operator presence control bar can malfunction and cause the engine and blades to continue to operate when they should shut off, posing a laceration hazard to the operator. Units: About 235,000 (27,000 of which were sold in Canada).

title: Sherwood Marketing Recalls 3 Squares Rice and Slow Cookers Due to Fire, Electric Shock Hazards
summary: The rice/slow cooker's improperly installed wiring can cause electrical shorting in the unit, posing fire and electric shock hazards. Units: About 175,000 (in addition, 100 were sold in Canada).

title: TUSA Recalls Diving Computers Due to Drowning and Injury Hazards
summary: The dive computer can malfunction and display an incorrect reading to the diver, posing a drowning and injury hazard due to decompression sickness. Units: About 175.
